transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay, so, this is a brainstorm. No decisions today unless we really have to. Let's just throw ideas around about pricing.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Love that. Can I start with the wild one?

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Please.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: What if we gave the first month free to every office? Like, just free. And then we, we convert them.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: That would kill our margin. I mean, on paper, a free month is, what, eight percent of the first year.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Sure, but imagine the signups.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Imagine if we had a billion customers, too.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Ha, ha.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Wild is fine. Keep going.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Okay, what if we went to annual billing only? We'd get the cash up front.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Would customers go for that? Offices like monthly.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Some would. The bigger ones, probably. It's hypothetical.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Harbor Cafe has actually asked about it. Not in so many words. They asked if there was a discount for paying yearly.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Interesting. That's a real signal.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: I could, I could ask them directly. Whether they would pay for an annual plan, and how big a discount they would need. I'll try to get to it, but this month is crazy with the renewals.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: No pressure. Whenever.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: What if we also did tiers for the tea? Like, a basic tea, a premium tea, a, a collector's tea.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: A collector's tea. Ha.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: I'm serious, there are people who collect these. We could do limited editions.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: It would complicate the supply. Kessler ships once a month.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: True. It's just an idea.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: What if the Sampler plan went from twenty-nine to thirty-five? Would anybody notice?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Customers would notice.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Do we need to increase the Sampler?

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Not really. The numbers are fine on Sampler. It's Classic that is the question.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: So let's say we leave the Sampler where it is for now. Anyone object?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: No.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: No.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: No.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay, so Sampler stays as is. That's the only thing we are deciding today.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Could we bundle the tea with some mugs? I'd buy that.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Mugs from where? We'd need a vendor.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: If there was a vendor. I'm only thinking out loud.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Would there be a margin on mugs, though? I'd guess not.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: We could consider it down the line. Not now.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: What about a referral thing, where the customer who brings a friend gets a free box?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: We had that at my last job. It was fine. It was, like, a third of the signups.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Hm, that sounds interesting. If we did it, it could replace some of the ad spend.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: If we dropped ads altogether we'd, we'd save forty thousand a year.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: We're not dropping ads altogether.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: I know. I'm just saying.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay. Now, Classic. Tom, what do we know about the churn?

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Honestly, I don't have the current number. I have it from March. It was, I think, four percent a month, but I'd want to check.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: That would be useful before we talk price on Classic.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Yeah. I'll pull the churn numbers for the Classic plan. I can get them to you by Friday.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Friday the twelfth. Great.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Sure.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Did anyone try the new place for lunch?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: The noodle one? It's incredible.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: I'm going to go there after.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Who's coming?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Me.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: I will, as long as it's not raining.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay. Back to it. Is there anything else on price?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: In theory we could do dynamic pricing, depending on the season. Winter, higher.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: People would be so annoyed.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Yeah, yeah. Theoretical.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay. So to wrap up. Sampler unchanged. Tom looks at Classic churn. Sofia talks to Harbor. Everything else is just ideas.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Works for me.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Good session.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Yeah, fun.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Thanks everybody.

decisions.text: Keep the Sampler plan price unchanged for now
